phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with limited enemy information and your own economy expanding.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have scouted enemy tech or when you are ready to take a third base.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansion, maintain Queens for defense, and stay alert for enemy tech.
phase_policies.target: Continue expanding and increasing economy while maintaining a defensive ground posture. Keep producing Queens for defense and creep spread.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy and Queen Defense
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy at the expense of neglecting defensive unit production or scouting; ensure you have sufficient army to defend against early aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, around 4-6 minutes, with enemy showing ground units (Zealots, Stalkers) or unknown posture, and you are expanding.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see enemy tech buildings, a large army movement, or more air units.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance ground army strength with expansion, adapt to enemy tech, and maintain scouting.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army with Zerglings and possibly Roaches, continue expanding and increasing production, and maintain scouting to detect tech switches. If enemy shows air (Phoenix/Oracle), prepare anti-air with Hydralisks or Spore Crawlers.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Ground Army and Tech Adaptation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single composition without scouting; avoid neglecting anti-air if enemy air is detected, and do not ignore defense while expanding.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, around 7-9 minutes, with enemy having a heavy ground army including Sentries and Observers, or transitioning to air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a significant army advantage, when enemy makes a tech switch, or when you have a sufficient air force.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground army, adapt to enemy composition, and maintain map presence.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and tech, adding Roaches or Hydralisks for anti-armor. Maintain map control and prepare for a decisive battle. If enemy transitions to air, consider adding anti-air or transitioning to Mutalisks.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if enemy shows air units; avoid overextending without map control, and do not ignore economy while building army.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with enemy having heavy ground or air presence, and you have a strong economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have a significant army advantage, when enemy makes a tech switch, or when you have a sufficient air force.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Adapt army composition to enemy, maintain economy, and prepare for decisive engagement.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and tech, adding Roaches or Hydralisks for anti-armor. If enemy has heavy air, transition to air units like Mutalisks or Corruptors to counter. Maintain map control and prepare for a decisive battle.
phase_policies.title: Late-Mid Army and Tech Adaptation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single composition without scouting; avoid neglecting anti-air if enemy air is present, and do not ignore defense while teching.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
